tasks.label: Git Commit Embossed Fix
tasks.command:
cd /Volumes/BackUP/Braille-OCR && git add src/js/detection/simple-braille-detector.js src/js/processing/image-enhance.js && git commit -m 'fix: adaptive threshold + corrected area bounds for embossed Braille detection

- Replace global Otsu with cv.adaptiveThreshold(ADAPTIVE_THRESH_MEAN_C, THRESH_BINARY_INV)
  in embossed detection path; blockSize dynamically scaled to ~2x estimated dot
  diameter (sqrt(imgArea)*0.022) so threshold is local and not biased by unsharp halos
- Reduce unsharpMask amount 2.5→1.2 in preprocessForBraille(embossed=true):
  previous amount created halos that dominated the Otsu histogram causing
  22% of pixels to be marked dark (148 blobs) instead of the true ~30 Braille dots
- Tighten _extractDots area bounds: minArea max(20, imgArea*0.0002), maxArea
  max(300, imgArea*0.012) — previously max(4, imgArea*0.00005) allowed noise blobs
  at 50px; real dots at 1280px are ~260-450px area
- Reduce MorphOpen from 5x5→3x3 for embossed path (smaller kernel appropriate
  when unsharp is gentle); raise circularity threshold 0.25→0.35

Diagnostic result: 20 dots detected (was 148→36 cells+garbage text),
all in single Y-band 180-266px, radii 11-13px — matches expected HELLO WORLD
Braille dot geometry at 1280px scale.' && git push origin openCV
